messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | Renewable Energy, Government Relations & ESG Leadership
messages.body:
Dear People Connect Global Team,

Your executive-search coverage across the UAE and GCC, including renewable energy, manufacturing and government leadership, aligns closely with my profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where responsible growth, public-sector engagement and institutional trust are essential. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
